newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Boral to sell U.S. gypsum division.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Boral to sell U.S. gypsum division.

text.p: Boral Ltd said on Thursday it would sell its United States wallboard unit Boral Gypsum Inc, which is based in Arkansas and had 1995/96 sales of US$81.0 million.
Boral Gypsum trades as Briar Gypsum.

"Despite Briar Gypsum's strong performance, it does not fit Boral's criteria of holding, or having the potential to hold, a leading position in the U.S. plasterboard market under Boral's stewardship," managing director Tony Berg said in a statement.
"This move reflects the company strategy to continue refocusing its business by disposing of non-core assets."
Boral has raised A$324 million from the sale of 18 businesses over the last two years.
At 3.50 p.m. (0550 GMT), Boral shares were one cent down at A$3.29. -- Sydney Newsroom 61-2 373 1800
